name: Funny Animal Stunts
summary: Turns a character reference image, an animal, an environment and a 10- or 15-second duration into a finished photorealistic prompt for the viral animal-rider stunt: the rider approaches a ramp, launches with the animal, separates, rotates in the air, and lands back on the SAME animal.
use_when: The user wants a viral animal stunt video, a bull-riding or elephant-jump flip clip, eyewitness-style smartphone footage of an impossible animal trick, or wants to recreate the mounted-launch-flip-remount format with a different character, animal or environment.
produces: One finished photorealistic text-to-video prompt for a 10- or 15-second viral animal-rider stunt clip, with the closed-loop stunt beats and the camera treatment locked.
